uM8XH_E1f8idvayeac78V.jobDescription:
SAFETY PROCEDURE (COMPANY)
===========================
Ensure compliance with safety procedures according to the company policy and requirements.

JOB REFERENCE DETAILS
===================
Manual Name: H-6 SHILLING RUDDER (MAKER PLAN);5303.pdf
Pdf Page No: 27
Chapter: 3. Check And Repair


DESCRIPTION
===========
1. Disassemble the casing and seal ring carefully, following safety protocols.
2. Inspect the condition of the mating faces for any signs of wear or damage, ensuring they are clean and properly aligned.
3. Measure the leakage volume and, if applicable, check the water -injection volume to confirm it is within operational parameters.
Note:
Carry out this job when any leakage is found.
